## What he builds

Production SaaS and full stack systems: multi-tenant data isolation (PostgreSQL RLS), NestJS/Node backends, Angular and React/Next.js frontends, payments, and AWS deployments.

## Why companies hire him

- Client delivery ownership — Green Power India live corporate platform (UI, schema, API, handoff)
- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture — Tagtics with PostgreSQL RLS
- Production payments and cloud ops — Fashion Studio on AWS EC2 with Razorpay webhooks
- Enterprise Angular depth — Axolon day job; Ever-Gauzy auth UI contribution

## Projects (authoritative)

### Green Power India (Client Contract, 2026)
Owned end-to-end delivery of a live corporate platform for a waste-to-energy brand — frontend, schema, API, and client handoff.
Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
Live: https://greenpowerindia.com/
Case study: https://www.rishiraj-sajeev.space/work/green-power-india

### Tagtics (SaaS, 2025)
Multi-tenant UI feedback SaaS — feedback pinned to exact DOM elements; PostgreSQL RLS so each tenant only sees its own data. React frontend live; Supabase-backed API work continues.
Stack: React, Supabase, PostgreSQL, RLS, TypeScript, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
Live: https://www.tagtics.online
Docs: https://tagtics.online/docs
Source: https://github.com/tagtics/tagtics-frontend
Case study: https://www.rishiraj-sajeev.space/work/tagtics

### Fashion Studio (E-Commerce, 2024)
Production e-commerce backend on self-managed AWS — catalogue, auth, orders, and verified Razorpay payments.
Stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, AWS EC2, Nginx
Source: https://github.com/rishi-rj-s/RSBackend

### Ever-Gauzy (Open Source, 2025)
Improved authentication UI in a 100k+ line NestJS/Angular ERP used by real organisations.
Stack: NestJS, Angular, TypeScript, Nx, CQRS
Live: https://app.gauzy.co/#/auth/login
Source: https://github.com/ever-co/ever-gauzy
